apps.name: FileManager
apps.subtitle: Real security for your files, nothing else
apps.localizedDescription: FileManager is a local, sideloaded file manager for iOS that treats security as a first-class feature instead of an afterthought. Hide folders, lock them behind Face ID, password-protect PDFs with a real owner/user password, and build AES-256 encrypted zip archives, all without an account, a server, or any analytics. A hidden second vault and a configurable self-destruct after repeated failed Face ID attempts are built in for anything that needs to stay truly private.
